baseline: 3204fa2 (0.8.3); fixes on main up to b0d9102
method: LLM agents under the author's direction, not independent review: five read-only agents (IPC, network, secrets, FFI, content) at 3204fa2, with the SDK, lipstick, sailjail, sailfish-secrets and Qt 5.6 sources and the Sailfish OS 5.1 SDK target and a 5.1 port image; host harnesses for the HTML path, Mp4 (ASan/UBSan) and the QR decoder; cargo audit and cargo deny. No device for the analysis. Invisible fixes 67019c7, the author's decisions a5266e1 and 5131d6c, corrections c8de0de, 4833d40, b0d9102. Report ids are kept (IPC, NET, SEC, FFI, UC); findings about the platform itself went to Jolla separately and are not listed; UC15 had no id in its report; the author's decisions are DEC1 to DEC25. See 2026-11-27-security.md.

non_findings.what: TLS: rustls with aws-lc-rs and the platform verifier on the system's CA bundle, TLS 1.2 at least, danger_accept_invalid_certs never set; Rustrx makes no HTTP requests outside the SDK.
OAuth state and PKCE are made and checked by the SDK; both loopbacks bind 127.0.0.1, never 0.0.0.0.
Key backup: the SDK enables a backup only when the recovery key's public key matches the server's backup version.
Identity reset: the approval URL comes from the account service's metadata; a password (UIAA) reset is refused; both behind a RemorsePopup.
The recovery key field sets ImhSensitiveData and ImhNoPredictiveText.
The home screen shows notification summary and body as plain text (5.1 target); lipstick announces no body-markup.
Silica's Notices, PageHeader, MenuItem, ValueButton, TextSwitch, SectionHeader and DialogHeader are Labels; DetailItem sets PlainText.
Every StyledText site in qml/ takes escaped or rendered text (16 sites read).
hrefSafe percent-encodes both quotes, which StyledText's value parser needs and is enough; " is not decoded in hrefs.
Mp4::read and strip: 3 million mutated inputs under ASan and UBSan, no report.
At 3204fa2 the eight unsafe blocks in core/ were all in lib.rs and sound as used (67019c7 added an openat in timeline.rs, export_new_file, not read by the audit).
rustrx_start, rustrx_command, rustrx_command_to and rustrx_set_store_key: no panic on input found; serde_json's recursion limit stops deep nesting.
The callback's fromRawData text lives until it returns and fromJson copies it; the Account pointer is never freed.
The KDF: the stores' high-entropy path wraps each database's cipher with HKDF-SHA256; one wrapping key for every store is fine (own data keys, random 192-bit nonces).
The journal on the 5.1 port image: volatile, about 1 MB, readable by root and the journal groups only.
Backups on the 5.1 port image: no jolla-vault unit reads Rustrx's data, config or cache folders.
The UnifiedPush token is a random UUID v4, checked by every connector method; the endpoint must be https.
